lines: Two answers are still needed from you, each a yes or no, and neither holds the film up. One, take the level line's mend, which shows on the live page at low quality only. Two, take the two what-ifs that both fresh reviewers said to take: fall's lit faces going out before winter's base comes, and summer's sand mound breaking up as it leaves. You can answer the second by eye: Preview 11 is the film without them and Preview 12 is the film with them.

The low resolution film is ahead of the time I named. At 11:07 AM MT 9 of its 12 parts are drawn and checked, each 150 frames with the build's hash and the calibration equal and no page message. The last three are being drawn and the last is expected about 11:17 AM MT. Joining it to the prompt opening and the sound, and my own look at it, take a few minutes more, so Preview 11 should be attached here before 11:30 AM MT instead of 11:45 AM. The two pictures attached are frames taken from the parts already in. Preview 12 follows when its two parts are in, limit 11:25 AM MT.

A correction to Preview 10. Its lower half was drawn on a branch that held a third change besides the two what-ifs I asked you about: fall's leaves moving from the landing frame, a what-if that failed its own measure and was never offered. I found this at 10:50 AM MT by reading the branch's history. Measured on Preview 10's own files, the two halves differ where the sand mound leaves (film frames 2108 to 2110) and again from frame 2120 on, after the change into fall, which I read as that third change. The sand mound and fall's faces were shown rightly. Preview 12 is drawn on a clean branch that holds only the two offered what-ifs, and no part from the old branch goes into it.
Phases 0 to 5 are complete. Phase 6, the films and delivery, is open.

Landed since the last status. The render instructions for your PC are mended on the three points the fresh reader named and pushed to their branch, with 12 tests added (1,387 pass by its builder's count). Their one hosted proof began at 11:03 AM MT, run 46173757954. The last such run took 66 minutes, so its result comes after 12:10 PM MT. The file goes onto the main branch only when every row of that proof passes and the same reader says yes.

The what-if for summer's lights during the shake has its motion proof from three machines, nine frames at 4K as the masters draw them. All three find the flat squares gone, and all three find that a stroke does not carry on where the frame before left it. Two find that small white lights turn into round dots. Those findings speak against it. Its builder's report is due 11:50 AM MT. It is not offered and it is in neither film.

The page that loses its drawing on hosted Macs, open item 295, measured on hosted Macs only. The cause is narrowed to one moment: the loss needs the controls mounted and the live picture's first step into sight together, while the graphics card is still busy. With either one taken away no load lost its drawing, 0 of 10 in each of four trials, against 4 of 12 to 12 of 25 lost as the page stands, by the finder's count. One more measuring run is allowed. No mend is built, and a mend that changes how the first picture comes in would be yours to decide.

Open and awaited in Mountain Time, by my orders' limits. Preview 11 before 11:30 AM. Preview 12 after 11:25 AM. The lights' report 11:50 AM. The lost drawing's ten must items 11:45 AM, then a second fresh reviewer before anything merges. The sand sprinkle's tip, its rework, about 11:55 AM (my last status named the sand mound's arrival there by mistake, and that one is not ordered, since no new look work starts without your word). The render instructions' proof after 12:10 PM. The hosted Mac report's second version 12:30 PM. The veil's what-if by 1:45 PM.

Remaining in phase 6 and what you receive. First the low resolution film, Preview 11 and Preview 12, today. Then the render instructions: one file in the repo and one line to give Claude Code. On your word after the film: the freeze, the repo goes private and the references are redrawn. Then the full 4K 60 render on your gaming PC, on your word only: With Prompt and Without Prompt at 3840x2160, the Portfolio Looping Video and the Portfolio Screenshot. Last the fresh review and BUILD COMPLETE. No 4K render is started or handed over. Sound credits 7,420 of 10,000 (measured from the ledger at 11:05 AM MT Saturday, 52 rows, the last call 10:47 PM MT Wednesday).
